governingAssessmentBaseline.relationship: 32 CFR Part 170 incorporates NIST SP 800-171 Revision 2 and NIST SP 800-171A June 2018 by reference for the current CMMC Level 2 assessment baseline. The September 2024 CMMC Level 2 Assessment Guide version 2.13 provides DoD guidance and does not itself have the force and effect of law.

supplementalEngineeringBaseline.relationship: NIST SP 800-171 Revision 3 and NIST SP 800-171A Revision 3 are retained as the forward engineering and assessment crosswalk. They do not replace the Revision 2 and June 2018 publications incorporated by reference in 32 CFR Part 170 unless the governing rule changes.

evidenceRule.findingEligibility: Only a final artifact whose SHA-256 is verified, whose exact source and release revisions are recorded, and whose objective-level mapping, owner, system scope, test result, and claim boundary are complete may be eligible to support an evidence finding.
evidenceRule.assessorAuthorityBoundary: Product and organization evidence may support an assessment but cannot create an assessor determination. An assessor determination must be imported as a separately signed, final, hashed assessor artifact owned by the assessor or assessment organization.

driftMonitoring.rule: Official-source drift blocks authority freshness and requires reviewed profile, catalog, mapping, and evidence regeneration. A detected change is never applied silently.
